name: @battleplan/infra
description: Project-wide Terraform for DynamoDB, the HTTP API, and the Lambda role.

scripts.test:local: bash -n ../scripts/tf-preflight.sh && bash -n ../scripts/tf-deploy.sh && bash -n ../scripts/tf-destroy.sh && terraform fmt -check -recursive && terraform -chdir=bootstrap init -backend=false -input=false && terraform -chdir=bootstrap validate && terraform init -backend=false -input=false && terraform validate
scripts.test:agent: bash -n ../scripts/tf-preflight.sh && bash -n ../scripts/tf-deploy.sh && bash -n ../scripts/tf-destroy.sh && terraform fmt -check -recursive && terraform -chdir=bootstrap init -backend=false -input=false && terraform -chdir=bootstrap validate && terraform init -backend=false -input=false && terraform validate
scripts.deploy:local: npm run deploy:local --prefix bootstrap && bash ../scripts/tf-deploy.sh local stack . infra
scripts.deploy:agent: npm run deploy:agent --prefix bootstrap && bash ../scripts/tf-deploy.sh agent stack . infra
